taskPacket.objective: Make the three tests contract A left red pass by completing what A changed, never by weakening an assertion.
instructions: Measured 2026-09-23, `npm test` after contract A: 1576 pass, 3 fail. (1) `single writer per field` in test/campaign/field-ownership.test.mjs: the new journal type `operator.command` (src/campaign/journal.mjs, written from src/campaign/index.mjs and the CLI for humanTouches) has no declared writer in docs/FIELD-OWNERSHIP.md. Declare it there in the format the document already uses, naming every module that appends it; if several modules append it, that is the defect the test exists for: give the event one writer.

(2) `manual covers every flag` in test/cli/manual.test.mjs: the `--ledger` flag of `faberun metrics` has no value description and no effect in the manual's flag table. Document it where the manual reads flag descriptions (src/cli/manual.mjs and its registry) and run `npm run docs` so docs/COMMANDS.md follows.

(3) D27 in test/harnesses/replay-run.test.mjs expects a rate indicator shaped {value, direction, count}; requirement R9 of the spec now makes every rate publish numerator, denominator and excludedRunIds. Update the expectation to the new shape with the real values the run produces; keep every other assertion.
Run the four verification commands; they are exactly the tests that failed plus the manual check.
decisions: This is campaign evidence-you-can-recompute of the leaving-home program; the spec is docs/campaigns/evidence-you-can-recompute/spec/SPEC.md and is the source of truth for every requirement this node carries. Read the requirement text there before writing code.

Follow AGENTS.md: plain ESM .mjs typed with JSDoc (npm run typecheck must stay clean), no file over 800 lines, no name exported from two src modules, no top-level body defined twice, no barrel modules, no empty catch, every module keeps a header comment saying what it owns and why it is separate, comments record measurement not intent.

No new runtime dependency; package.json keeps no `dependencies`. No test calls a provider. No test writes to the operator's real home: tests run with the --import ./test/scoped-home.mjs setup the verification commands use.
Do NOT edit .gitignore or any other ignore source: the controller fails a node that changes one (snapshot_ignore_changed).

The proof test is pinned: create the test with exactly the name the Definition of Done quotes, in exactly the file it names. A --test-name-pattern that matches nothing still exits 0, so the DoD also checks the name exists.
Reuse the pieces the spec names instead of reimplementing them; keep the diff to what the requirement forces.
Code, comments and documents are in English. Never run git commit or git push: the controller seals and integrates your work.
nonGoals: Any change outside what the three failures force
